raw_text: FACT CHECK: AI-generated image of Modi-Xi handshake at G20. An image showing PM Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping in an elaborate handshake is being shared as being from the G20 Delhi Summit. BOOM FactCheck analysis: 1) No such photo was released by official PMO or Xinhua feeds. 2) EXIF data is completely absent (typical of AI-generated images). 3) Hands show six fingers on one figure (common GAN artefact). 4) Background architecture does not match Bharat Mandapam venue. 5) Lighting inconsistency between subjects suggests composite. VERDICT: AI-generated, not a real photograph.
